plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Digital Media A.A. Degree - CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8010/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-62; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+15+15+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 Area 2 3-4 -> 3). Linked 'select the course not taken' pairs: RTVF 300/PHOTO 302 (Sem 1 takes one, Sem 2 takes the other); RTVF 330/RTVF 319 (Sem 1 takes one, Sem 3 takes the other — the printed footnote 'select course not taken in Semester 2' is an apparent typo since the 330/319 pair appeared in Semester 1, not Semester 2); RTVF 360/RTVF 362 (Sem 2 takes one, Sem 3 takes the other). RTVF 300 also listed as JOUR 310. GE LABEL NOTES: the Semester 2 row 'CalGETC Area 1B-Oral Communication' carries GE AREA 'Cal-GETC Area 1C' (Oral Communication is 1C); encoded as 1C. The Semester 3 row 'CalGETC Area 5A-Biological Sciences' carries GE AREA '5A' (apparent typo; encoded as 5B since Semester 4 holds the 5A-Physical Science course and CalGETC Area 5 requires both 5A and 5B). List A (minimum 3 units; one 3-unit slot in Semester 3): RTVF 350 (requires RTVF 330), RTVF 354 (advisory RTVF 362), RTVF 361 (requires RTVF 360), RTVF 365 (requires RTVF 362), RTVF 370, RTVF 371 (1 unit; requires RTVF 330 or 331), RTVF 498 (0.5-4 units). This program also meets the requirement for the Certificate of Achievement in Digital Media (no separate sequence published). Advisory: RTVF 304 advisory CISC 302 or JOUR 330; RTVF 368 advisory ENGL C1000. For transfer to CSU Sacramento Digital Media Program, COMM 311 & COMM 361 are preferred. Semester 1: map recommends meeting with a counselor (Area 1A and Area 2).
